title: Non-finito
summary: Six sentences trapped in a block of marble, released only as far as your viewport is wide and carved off with an ellipsis the browser alone inserts.
mechanism: CSS text-overflow:ellipsis + overflow:hidden truncates each line to the container width live on resize; the U+2026 glyph exists only in the render, absent from the DOM and from copy.
references: Michelangelo Buonarroti, the Prigioni / non-finito (Atlas, Bearded, Awakening Slaves, c. 1520-34)
the web 'read more' / line-clamp truncation pattern
